# Standards & federation

OpenCatalogi declares the standards below in its manifest. OpenRegister publishes them to other servers without login, under `opencatalogi.discovery` in `/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities`, so another instance can tell from a hostname alone whether it can connect. Tools such as [Nextcloud Peek](https://genhttp.dev/lambda/nextcloud-peek/) show it too.

## Standards this app provides

| Standard | Version | Access | Endpoint |
|---|---|---|---|
| [DCAT-AP-NL](https://docs.geostandaarden.nl/dcat/dcat-ap-nl30/) | 3.0 | Public | `/apps/opencatalogi/api/dcat` |
| [DiWoo metadata sitemaps for the Woo-index](https://standaarden.overheid.nl/diwoo/metadata) | 0.9.8 | Public | — |
| [TOOI identifiers in published DiWoo and DCAT metadata](https://standaarden.overheid.nl/tooi) | — | Public | — |
| [schema.org JSON-LD per catalog](https://schema.org/) | — | Public | — |
| [Open Education API](https://openonderwijsapi.nl/) | 5.0 | Nextcloud login | — |
| [OpenAPI description of the public API](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.0) | 3.1 | Public | `/apps/opencatalogi/api/openapi.json` |
| OpenCatalogi directory and federation protocol | — | Public | `/apps/opencatalogi/api/federation/publications` |

## Standards this app uses

These are standards the app acts as a client of. They tell another server what this app can connect *to*.

| Standard | Version |
|---|---|
| OpenCatalogi directory and federation protocol (peer directories) | — |

## Public entry points

| Name | Path |
|---|---|
| directory | `/apps/opencatalogi/api/directory` |
| openapi | `/apps/opencatalogi/api/openapi.json` |
| robots | `/apps/opencatalogi/api/robots.txt` |

## Federation (Open Cloud Mesh)

OpenCatalogi registers no Open Cloud Mesh resource type of its own. Objects it stores in OpenRegister can still be shared with another instance through OpenRegister's `openregister` resource type.

## How another server finds this

```bash
curl -s -H 'OCS-APIRequest: true' \
  'https://cloud.example.org/ocs/v2.php/cloud/capabilities?format=json' \
  | jq '.ocs.data.capabilities["opencatalogi"].discovery'
```

Paths are relative to the instance root. Prefix `/index.php` when the instance runs without pretty URLs (`core.mod-rewrite-working` is false). Endpoints that need a Nextcloud login are listed without their path.

## Administrators

- Stop publishing discovery for every app: `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_public --value=no`
- Hide only this app: add `opencatalogi` to `occ config:app:set openregister discovery_hidden_apps --value=...` (comma separated)

Field reference and the shared list of standard ids: [Discovery and federation](https://github.com/ConductionNL/openregister/blob/development/docs/Technical/discovery-and-federation.md).
